name: Pigeon
overview: The Bible presents the pigeon, often referred to alongside turtledoves, as an acceptable offering in the sacrificial system, particularly for those unable to bring larger animals like lambs. These birds were used for sin offerings and burnt offerings, signifying atonement and dedication to the Lord, as seen in the detailed instructions given in Leviticus and affirmed in Luke. The use of pigeons in sacrifice underscores God's provision for all believers to approach Him in repentance and worship, regardless of their means.
